notes.title: Free Demo available now!
notes.content:
[h3][b]The day has come![/b] – we’ve just released the [b]free demo![/b][/h3]  
You can all download it now and step into the shoes of a rookie politician!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/c330e3d68a9c3a390482ca41f8552ca70427298f.png[/img]

[b]What can you expect in the demo version? A proper introduction to the political rat race, including:[/b]  
[list]  
[*] A story-driven intro that immerses you in the absurd world of Polish politics  
[*] Early missions like founding your own party and winning over your first voters  
[*] Core gameplay mechanics – exploration, combat, minigames, environmental interactions – with a tutorial  
[*] And loads of humor!  
[/list]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/c8c474a9796e49b4f5dc9e7ef8304737ba688d13.gif[/img]

Jump into the Polish political scene with a bang and lead your politician from a green backbencher straight to the prime minister’s seat. Make choices that will test your morals and creativity. From innocent little lies in local interviews to ritual cow-milking under the TV spotlight – there are many ways to climb the ladder, but is it always worth the risk? The answer: “it depends.” One thing's for sure – you should definitely grab the free demo and find out for yourself!

[h3]Play the demo now![/h3]  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3609770/Sejm_The_Game_Demo/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035912/7fcdd2aec7d1a7e58489635a7664c58bc03bc07f.gif[/img]

Add the game to your wishlist and follow it on Steam so you don’t miss the full release! Now get to work – that electoral sausage won’t grill itself!

[h3]Politics The Game – Add the full version to your wishlist:[/h3]  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2999060/Sejm_The_Game/
